turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog has started sleeping in our bed and I need to decide what to do about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All the options first, comments after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could buy him a nice dog bed and put it right next to ours, so he's still close.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or crate train him in the kitchen at night with a blanket over the crate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could just give up and let him stay in the bed, he's a small dog after all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or close the bedroom door and let him have the whole living room sofa.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it, that's the lot. Your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you're sleeping badly, the bed beside yours is the best compromise. The crate is good if he's anxious and likes a den, the sofa is easy but could become a habit, and keeping him in your bed is only fine if you both sleep well.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but How do you clean a mattress? I've never done it in my life.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most people haven't. Strip the bed, vacuum the mattress with the upholstery tool, especially the seams.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sprinkle baking soda over the top, leave it for a few hours, then vacuum it up. It freshens it nicely.
